questions.knowledge_point: Identifying Entries of a Matrix Product Representing a 3x3 System of Equations
questions.worked_solution:
First, let's write the system so that $x$, $y$, and $z$ appear in each equation:

$$
{\begin{aligned}3x+0y+0z=6 \\ 2x+0y+z=2 \\ 3x+4y-2z=0\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}3 & 0 & 0 \\ 2 & 0 & 1 \\ 3 & 4 & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ 2 \\ 0\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 0 & 0 \\ 2 & 0 & 1 \\ 3 & 4 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ 2 \\ 0\end{aligned}].
$$

questions.problem:
The system of equations

$$
{\begin{aligned}3x+2y+8z=0 \\ 2x-5y+4z=3 \\ 5x-4y+7z=-2\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & a \\ 2 & b & 4 \\ 5 & c & 7\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3 \\ -2\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the values of $a,b$ and $c?$
questions.worked_solution:
We can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & 8 \\ 2 & -5 & 4 \\ 5 & -4 & 7\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3 \\ -2\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & 8 \\ 2 & -5 & 4 \\ 5 & -4 & 7\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3 \\ -2\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=8,\,b=-5,\,c=-4.$

$$

What are the values of $a,b$ and $c?$
questions.worked_solution:
First, let's write the system so that $x$, $y$, and $z$ appear in each equation:

$$
{\begin{aligned}0x+y+2z=0 \\ x+2y+3z=2 \\ 3x+y+z=-3\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 2 \\ 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 3 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2 \\ -3\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 2 \\ 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 3 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2 \\ -3\end{aligned}].
$$

questions.problem:
The system of equations

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}-2z+x-5y=1 \\ -y+5z-4x=-2 \\ 2x-6y-z=2\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -5 & a \\ b & -1 & 5 \\ 2 & c & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 2\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the values of $a,b$ and $c?$
questions.worked_solution:
First, let's write the system so that $x$, $y$, and $z$ appear in each equation in the correct order and all constants are on the right-hand side of the system:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x-5y-2z=1 \\ -4x-y+5z=-2 \\ 2x-6y-z=2\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & -5 & -2 \\ -4 & -1 & 5 \\ 2 & -6 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 2\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -5 & -2 \\ -4 & -1 & 5 \\ 2 & -6 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 2\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=-2,\,b=-4,\,c=-6.$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}-5x+2y+z=0 \\ 2x+0y+z=1 \\ -3x+7y-2z=0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-5 & 2 & 1 \\ 2 & 0 & 1 \\ -3 & 7 & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]
$$

$$

$$

Therefore, $a=2,\,b=1,\,c=-2.$
